title: GenRecon generates editable PBR mesh reconstructions of indoor environments from multi-view images
author: corysama

comments.author: corysama
comments.body:
AFAICT, this combines Trellis.2 with techniques from photogrammetry to generate meshes from indoor scenes. The big difference being that this uses the generative 3D to hallucinate parts of the objects that are not visible in the images and to improve the visual quality beyond what photogrammetry can strictly infer from just the image contents.

> Our method builds on the object-level 3D generation model Trellis.2.

> The concurrent work Pixal3D adopts a closely related conditioning strategy for 3D object-level generation.
